pre_registration_statement: This file and data/strategies.json are committed to git BEFORE pipeline/backtest.py is executed on the holdout seasons. The git history is the proof of ordering: the commit containing this file precedes the commit containing data/strategies/results.json.

inherits_from.note: Gate design and season splits are carried forward from the prior session's pre-registration so this hub does not silently re-tune on the same data. Thresholds here are project-defined, not official NFL values.

splits.rule: Hyper-parameters and bet-selection thresholds are chosen on dev/validation only. Holdout is scored exactly once by the committed pipeline.

gates.name: Provenance & integrity
gates.rule: Every input carries a URL, retrieval time and sha256; no duplicate game_id; scores consistent with result/total; standings reconcile to the official source.

gates.name: Positive net ROI
gates.rule: Holdout ROI > 0 after vig, priced at archived closing lines/odds (default -110 when odds missing).

gates.name: Luck removal
gates.rule: Week-clustered bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND placebo-permutation p < 0.05 AND Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 across the registered single-bet trials.

gates.name: Robustness
gates.rule: Positive ROI in >= 60% of holdout seasons and no single season contributes > 50% of total profit.

gates.name: No look-ahead
gates.rule: Features use only games strictly before the kickoff week; a perturbation test (rewriting future results) must leave predictions unchanged.

gates.name: Pricing realism
gates.rule: Bets priced at archived closing lines/odds. Parlay payouts use a stated assumption and are flagged; proxy markets FAIL G7 by construction.

gates.name: Forward replication
gates.rule: Prospective timestamped predictions for >= 1 full season. Cannot pass in this session; caps any strategy at Gold (provisional).

tiers.Silver: G1-G3 pass; raw significance passes but Holm or robustness fails
tiers.Bronze: G1-G3 pass; significance fails (indistinguishable from luck)
tiers.Research-only: G7 fails (proxy or assumed pricing) regardless of ROI
tiers.Blocked: Required input unavailable; value left blank and flagged

rewards.type: non-monetary reputation points only; no cash, prizes or pooled stakes
rewards.allocation: Split equally among strategies reaching Gold (provisional). If none pass, 0 awarded and the pool rolls over. Silver/Bronze receive recognition only.
rewards.why_non_monetary: Paying out on wagering outcomes raises licensing, tax and consumer-protection questions that are not resolved for this project; see the Open Questions register (Q-14).

controls.C1: Always bet the home favourite ATS at the closing line.
controls.C2: Random-side placebo, 2000 draws, used to calibrate how often luck alone produces the observed ROI.
